headline_seed: US Democrats finalise major shakeup to 2028 presidential primary calendar - Al Jazeera
draft_text:
#BreakingMews: Al Jazeera English reports Democrats voted Saturday in Austin to set South Carolina as the first 2028 presidential primary contest, on January 22, 2028.

reported by Al Jazeera English; also covered by Associated Press, The New York Times, The Washington Post
